title: pH from Hydrogen Ion Concentration

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Defines pH as the negative base-10 logarithm of the hydrogen ion (H⁺) activity/concentration in a solution — lower pH means higher H⁺ concentration (more acidic), higher pH means lower H⁺ concentration (more basic).
commonMistakes: Forgetting that each whole pH unit represents a 10-fold change in H⁺ concentration, not a linear change.
